status: Prose design only; not implemented, released, executed or authorized here
purpose: Expose already-fixed checkpoint interfaces, without new scientific arms or checkpoint selection
steps: Wait for the existing coherent complete15-fit closure and retained checkpoint/logit replays; do not use the parent 14/15 status as eligibility. Bind exact original registry/V6 source/consumer/runtime and each final selected checkpoint descriptor after authorized custody review.

Use a separately reviewed labels-free exporter on fresh constructed copies. Preserve the exact portable image restore (native_training.build and restore), including the stored selected _global flag; never force global stage or select a different epoch. Use only the bound public feature/edge projection with identical raw FP32 features and to_undirected/remove_self_loops/add_self_loops preprocessing. Do not call common.load_data as a labels-free reader: it decodes TRAIN and VAL packs.

Attach a passive forward pre-hook to only the selected active head: GNNM local_head/global_head captures (h,member); native pred_local/pred_global captures (h,). Hook returns None, changes no values/parameters and records raw head arguments before boundary R. Require exactly four member calls0..3 for GNNM and one native call, each [24492,512] FP32, and keep own local/global interface tags.

Run one complete eval/no_grad forward per unique physical fit on the full graph. Stream detached CPU clones to an export artifact outside every sealed scientific/source outcome root. Do not call train_step or portable_replay (the latter performs scratch FIT updates); the existing qualified next-step replay remains a preceding custody gate rather than extra export work.

Require resulting complete raw logits to match both selected checkpoint selected_raw_logits and SELECTED_LOGITS.pt under the existing fixed logit tolerance rtol=1e-5,atol=1e-6. Bind exact member/node/class axes, selected stage/checkpoint, graph/preprocessing hash, source/runtime hash, raw-hidden-before-R interface, dtype/shape and export file hash/size. Export no labels or metrics and revalidate original source/custody pins; mismatch stops export, with no tolerance widening or reselection.

Assemble GNNM bank [4,N,512] in hook member order and independent bank [4,N,512] by registry references. Keep mixed selected-stage tags for independent members. The single_author view aliases independent member 0; no additional forward/artifact duplicate. Use concatenation interfaces; source does not certify aligned channels or justify elementwise averaging of independently learned hidden states.
minimal_work: 15 complete model eval calls =24 complete member trajectories across3blocks; no base fit, extra epoch, selector or new arm. Raw H storage1,203,830,784 bytes plus overhead if allN/512/FP32 states are retained. This is an analytical requirement, not a measured latency/resource admission.
optional_amortization_limit: Capturing with passive hooks during an already mandatory authorized replay could avoid a duplicated neural forward only if a separate reviewed export addition is explicitly approved. It cannot be assumed free or inserted into frozen source now. The standalone plan above charges its full replay.
roles: Extraction needs no TRAIN/VAL/TEST label values; full-node public features and public TEST membership are transductive inputs. Every frozen label/selector role and existing family predictor remain unchanged. No readout is trained in this plan.
